name: nt-dev
description: Everyday development workflow: /nt-dev:pr writes a PR body against the template, /nt-dev:cleanup audits a repo for drift, /nt-dev:recall reads a prior session back into context, /nt-dev:issue writes a GitHub issue to the house standard, /nt-dev:eod-update writes a copy-paste end-of-day standup update from today's GitHub activity (never posts). Two hooks back the skills up: one points a bare gh call at the skill holding the house standard, and one names every line where a write raises the unicode-dash count, so the dash gate never fails the PR.
